description: A Next.js App Router Stripe webhook with no signature verification — the single most common shape emitted by Lovable, v0 and Bolt. It never says 'stripe' in the body: the directory app/api/webhooks/stripe/ carries the identity. VC005 required the literal string in the file content, so this entire shape was invisible to a critical payment rule. Anyone who knows the URL could forge checkout.session.completed and grant themselves access.
